levels.name: First Words

units.title: Hello, Friends!
units.objective: Greet, say goodbye, say their name and express how they feel.

structures.en: Hello! / Hi! / Good morning!
What's your name? — My name is Ana.
How are you? — I'm happy.
Goodbye! See you tomorrow!

classes.structure: Hello, Milo! / Goodbye, Milo!

classes.evidence: Answers the greeting with a word + gesture

classes.vocab: name, boy, girl, friend
classes.structure: What's your name? — My name is ___.
classes.activity: Pass the Ball: whoever has the ball says their name
classes.evidence: Says their name in English without help
classes.sentence: What's your name?

classes.vocab: happy, sad, angry, sleepy, hungry, fine
classes.structure: How are you? — I'm happy.
classes.activity: Feelings Faces: copy the emotion on the card
classes.evidence: Names 3 emotions and answers How are you?
classes.sentence: How are you?

classes.vocab: boy, girl, please, thank you, sorry
classes.structure: Stand up, boys! / Thank you!
classes.activity: TPR: Stand up - Sit down following the instruction
classes.sentence: Stand up, boys!

classes.vocab: repaso integral de la unidad
classes.structure: Hello! My name is ___. I'm happy.
classes.activity: Mini presentation in front of the class with the puppet
classes.sentence: Hello! My name is Ana. I'm happy

units.song: 'Hello Song' and 'Bye Bye Goodbye' (Super Simple Songs).
units.games: Hello Train (greeting train) · Pass the Ball (names) · The puppet asks · Feelings Faces (emotion mime)
units.materials: Class pet puppet (e.g. 'Milo the Monkey') · Soft ball · Name flashcards · Emotion flashcards · Speaker and song list
units.phonics: Simple rhymes (hello / yellow), clap the syllables of their own name, initial sound /h/ in hello.
units.evaluation: Checklist: greets, says their name, answers 'How are you?' and says goodbye.
units.project: Page 1 of the 'Hello Book': cover with their name and a face showing how they feel.

units.objective: Identify and name 8-10 colors, count from 1 to 10 and answer 'How many?'.

levels.duration: 20 clases (4 unidades x 5 clases) · 45 min por clase · 2 clases por semana
levels.goal: That the child understands and produces their first words and sentences in English in classroom situations: greeting, naming colors, counting, pointing to their body, talking about their family, their toys and their favorite animals.
